content: Aramas akan Kaulimala
Eri, pwohng ehu pwon aramas ako sengisengki ar pwunod.
Re ahpw lipahnedihada Moses oh Aaron, ketihtihki, “Me pahn mwahu atail mehlahte nan Isip de nan sapwtehn wet!

Dahme KAUN-O ketikinkitaildohki nan sahpw wet? Kitail uhdahn pahn mehla nan mahwen; eri, atail pwoud kan oh neitail seri kan pahn wiahla dipwisou me lohdi mahwen. Atail pwuralahng Isip soh pahn mwahusang met?”
Irail eri tapihada ndapene, “Nna, kitail pilada emen me pahn kapwureikitailahng Isip.”
Eri, Moses oh Aaron ahpw poaridi nanpwel mwohn pokon en mehn Israel ko.
Oh riemen lipoahrok ko, me dawih sahpwo, Sosua, nein Nun, oh Kalep, nein Sepune, ahpw tehrpeseng ara likou ko, uwen ara nsensuwed,
ira eri ndalahng aramas ako, “Sahpw me se dawihero iei sahpw mwahu ehu.
Ma KAUN-O ketin kupwurei kitail, e pahn ketin kahluwaikitaillahng nan sahpw kaselel wet oh ketikihong kitail.

Eri, kumwail dehr kahngohdiong KAUN-O. Kumwail dehr masak tohnsahpw wet; me mengei kitail en kaloweiraildi. KAUN-O pahn ketin ieiang kitail. E ketin kamwomwala ar koht akan, mehn doareparail. Kumwail dehr masak!”
Ahpw pokono wie songosong en katehkin ira takai lao ira mehla; a ni ahnsowohte lingaling en KAUN-O pa sansalda pohn Impwalo.
Moses Kapakapki Aramas akan
KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Moses, “Ia erein aramas pwukat ar pahn mwamwahlikin ie? Ia erein ar pahn kahng kamehlele ie, ni ei wiadahr manaman tohtohie mwohn masarail kan?
Eri, I pahn kalokehkin irail soumwahu lusulus ehu pwe en kemeirailla. A kowe, I pahn wiahkin uhk wehi kapw ehu, wehi ehu me pahn lapalapasang oh tohtohsang irail.”
Moses ahpw sapeng KAUN-O, patohwan, “Komwi me ketikihsang aramas pwukat nan Isip ni manaman lapalap en nin limomwi. A ni mehn Isip ar pahn rong dahme komw ketin wiahiong sapwellimomwi aramas pwukat,

re soh pahn patohwanohng tohnsahpw wet? Pwe re pil iangehr rong duwen komwi, Maing KAUN, duwen omwi kin ketin ieiang kiht, duwen omwi kin ketin pwarada ni sansal mwohn masat ni ahnsou me sapwellimomwi pelien depweko eh kin uhdi poht, oh pil duwen omwi kin ketieng mwoht ni rahn ni mwomwen uhr depwek oh nipwong ni mwomwen uhr kisiniei.
Eri, ma komw pahn ketin kemehla sapwellimomwi aramas pwukat koaros, tohnwehi kan me rongehr duwen omwi ndand, pahn patohwan,
‘KAUN-O sohte eh manaman pwe en ketikihong sapwellime aramas akan nan sahpw me e ketin inoukihong irail; ihme kahrehda e ketin kauwehkinirailla nan sapwtehn.’
Eri, Maing KAUN, komw ketin kasalehda roson en sapwellimomwi manaman, oh wiahda dahme komw ketin inoukihong kiht ni sapwellimomwi mahsen wet,

‘Ngehi me KAUN-O, eri, I kin kanengamah oh kalahngan oh limpoak poatopoat; I kin mahkikihong dihp oh suwed en aramas; ahpw I pahn kaloke seri kan lel dih kesiluh oh kapahieu pwehki dipen ar pahpa oh nohno kan.’
Eri, komw ketin kupwurkalahngan mahkikihong dipen aramas pwukat, duwen me konehng omwi limpoak lapalap oh poatopoat, nin duwen omwi ketin wiahiongirailehr sang ni ar mweselsang wehin Isip.”
KAUN-O eri mahsanih, “Eri, I pahn mahkohng irail duwen me ke pekien.
Ahpw I kahukihla ni mwarei oh pil ni ei lingaling me kin kadirehla sampah,

me sohte emen nanpwungen aramas pwukat pahn pedolong nan sapwen inowo. Re kilangehr ei lingaling oh pil manaman akan me I wiadahr nan Isip oh pil nan sapwtehno; irail ahpw uhwong ie pak tohto oh sohte peikiong ie.
Eri, re sohte pahn pedolong nan sahpw wet me I inoukihong ar pahpa kahlap ako, sohte emen irail me mwamwahlikin ie pahn iang pedolong loale.
Ahpw ei ladu Kalep kasalehda ehu soangen mour tohrohr oh e kin loalopwoatohng ie; ihme I pahn kahluwahng ih nan sahpw me e dawih oh kasawih, oh kadaudoke kan pahn sapwenikihla
wasa patapat akan, wasa me mehn Amalek oh mehn Kenan kin kousoan ie met. Eri, lakapw kumwail mwesel oh pwurala nan sapwtehn kolahng ni Sehd Weitahta.”
KAUN-O ketin Kalokehki Aramas akan ar Kaulim
Eri, KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Moses oh Aaron,
“Ia erein pokon en aramas suwed pwukat ar pahn lipilipahnede ie? I pwahngahkidahr rongorong ar kaulim!
Eri, kihong irail ei pasapenget: ‘I kahukiha ni mwarei me I pahn wiahiong kumwail soahngohte me I rongasang kumwail. Ngehi, KAUN-O me mahmahsen.
Kumwail pahn mehla oh kahlepamwail kan pahn pwupwudiong nan sapwtehn wet. Pwehki amwail kaulimeielahr, sohte emen kumwail me mahkier sounpar rieisek kohda pahn pedolong nan sahpw
me I kahukilahr mehlel I en koasoaneikumwaildi ie. Sohte mehmen kumwail pahn pedolong, ihte Kalep oh Sosua.
Kumwail nda me noumwail seri kan pahn wiahla dipwisou lohdi nan mahwen, ahpw iei irail pwukat me I pahn kapedolong ong nan sahpw me kumwail soikalahr; eri, re pahn sapwenikihla.
A duwen kumwail, kumwail uhdahn pahn mehla nan sapwehten wet.
Noumwail seri kan pahn wiahla silepen sihpw oh kakahnseli nan sapwtehn erein sounpar 40, pweinen amwail soaloalopwoat, kumwail koaros lao pahn mehla.
Kumwail pahn ale lokolok pwehki dipamwail kan erein sounpar 40, sounpar ehu ong ehuehu rahn pahiseko me kumwail dawihki sahpwo. Kumwail eri pahn pehmada wehwehn ei pahn uhwong kumwail.
I kahukihla me I pahn wia soahng wet ong aramas suwed koaros me ehupene oh kahngohdihong ie. Kumwail koaros pahn mehla nan sapwtehn wet. Ngehi, KAUN-O, me mahmahsen.’”

Eri, ohl ako me Moses kadarala pwe re en dawih oh kasawih sahpwo, ahpw pwurodo oh wia koasoi likamw, me kahrehda mehn Israel ko kaulimehkihla KAUN-O oh lahlahwe. Eri, e ahpw ketin kalokehki lipoahrok pwukat soumwahu laud ehu me re mehkihla.
Sang rehn lipoahrok ehk riemeno, ihte me luhwehdi momour, Sosua oh Kalep.
Tepin Mwekid en Mahwenohng Sahpwo
Ni Moses eh kasalehiong mehn Israel ko sapwellimen KAUN-O mahsen pwukat, aramas ako inenen pahtoula oh nsensuwedla kowahlap.

Eri, mandahn rahno, nimensehngie, re ahpw kohdalahng mahwen wasa nahna kan, ndinda, “Nna, kitail patopatohdalahng wasa me KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong kitail duwe. Kitail patohwan ese me kitail dipadahr.”
Moses ahpw patohwan, “Eri, dahme kumwail pahn ketiwohki sapeikiong KAUN-O met? Kumwail sohte pahn pweida.
Kumwail dehr kohdawei, pwe KAUN-O sohte ketin ieiang kumwail; kumwail uhdahn pahn lohdiong pahn amwail imwintihti kan.
Ni amwail pahn mahweniong mehn Amalek kan oh mehn Kenan kan, kumwail uhdahn pahn kamakamala, pwehki amwail kahngalahr idawehn KAUN-O, me kahrehda e solahr pahn kin ketin ieiang kumwail.”
Irail ahpw wonlahte mwowe kohdalahng pohn nahna ko, mehnda ma sapwellimen KAUN-O Kohpwahn Inowo oh Moses sohte mwahn mwekidsang nan kahnimpwalo.
Eri, mehn Amalek oh Kenan ahpw kohiei mahweniong irail oh kaloweiraildi, re ahpw pil pwakih irail lao lel Orma.
